description: Allowlist enforced inside SurfaceAdapter.act(), below the model. A discovery agent that has been talked into an off-policy action still cannot perform one, because the refusal happens at the point of action with no model in the path.

web.comment: Only the local demo stack. Any other origin is a hard deny, including one reached by a redirect, because the check runs on the URL actually being navigated to. credentialEnvVars lists the NAMES a discovery agent may reference as {{env.NAME}} for sign-in — names are configuration, values are not, and an agent told neither will invent a name like USERNAME and stall.

terminal.comment: A character grid has no origins. What it does have is AID keys, and those are the entire action surface of a block-mode host — an unlisted key is refused rather than transmitted.

redaction.comment: Applied to everything written to disk: evidence, page dumps, action transcripts, discovery logs. Secrets are removed by VALUE as well as by pattern, because the reliable way to keep a credential out of a screenshot text dump is to know what it is.
